Run MS2 fragment annotation (Phase 1 + Phase 2)

run_isf_annotation.Rd

R wrapper around isf_annotate_cpp(). Identifies features whose mzmed matches a fragment ion of a confirmed precursor.

Usage

run_isf_annotation(
  phase1_result,
  ms2_list,
  FT,
  ppm_isf = 10,
  mz_threshold_isf = 0.005,
  rt_isf_threshold = 30
)

Arguments

phase1_result

data.frame. Output of annotateLibMatch(). Must contain columns feature_name, Lib_group, reference_tier, and Compound_M.

ms2_list

list. From read_ms2_consensus().

FT

data.frame. Full MS1 feature pool.

ppm_isf

Numeric. ppm tolerance for fragment matching. Default 10.

mz_threshold_isf

Numeric. Absolute m/z floor (Da). Default 0.005.

rt_isf_threshold

Numeric. RT window (s). Default 30.

Value

data.frame — see annotateISF().
